title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot carefully. Notice the pattern of the data points. Consider how the function $$f(x)=x$$ might fit this pattern.

title: Linear Relationship
text: The function $$f(x)=x$$ represents a linear relationship. Check if the data points in the scatterplot can be aligned with a straight line when using this function.

title: Checking the Fit
text: Does the function $$f(x)=x$$ allow the data points to be expressed as a linear combination in the form $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$?
